Quick Start Get up and running in 4 steps. Connect providers, route models, monitor everything.
1. Create API key Go to API Keys. Generate one key per environment.
2. Connect providers Add accounts in Providers. Supports OAuth, API Key, and free tiers.
3. Point your client Set base URL to http://localhost:20128/v1 in your IDE or API client.
4. Monitor & optimize Track tokens, cost and errors in Request Logs and Analytics.
